title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Monthly Cost Share Schedule by Sponsor Pay Grade
content:
The Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) is held in ten tiers, each named for the sponsor pay grades it applies to. The tier fixes the monthly cost share the sponsor family pays, in US dollars, for each calendar month in which the family receives any ECHO benefit.

## Schedule of monthly cost shares

| ECHO tier (official name) | Sponsor pay grades covered | Monthly cost share (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-1 to E-5 | E-1, E-2, E-3, E-4, E-5 | 25.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-6 | E-6 | 30.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-7 and O-1 | E-7, O-1 | 35.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-8 and O-2 | E-8, O-2 | 40.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-9, W-1, W-2 and O-3 | E-9, W-1, W-2, O-3 | 45.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor W-3, W-4 and O-4 | W-3, W-4, O-4 | 50.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor W-5 and O-5 | W-5, O-5 | 65.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor O-6 and O-7 | O-6, O-7 | 75.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor O-8 | O-8 | 100.00 |
| Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor O-9 and O-10 | O-9, O-10 | 150.00 |

The pay grade read for the tier is the sponsor pay grade on the beneficiary's record. Each tier's entry terms are the same apart from the pay grades: the beneficiary is an active duty family member or a transitional survivor, has a documented qualifying condition, is enrolled in the Exceptional Family Member Program, and holds TRICARE Prime or TRICARE Select as the basic program.

## Terms of assessment (identical in all ten tiers)

| Term | Value in every tier, Sponsor E-1 to E-5 through Sponsor O-9 and O-10 |
|---|---|
| Unit on which the monthly cost share is assessed | per sponsor family, per calendar month with ECHO benefits |
| Most monthly cost shares one sponsor family pays in a calendar month | 1 |
| Claim the monthly cost share is taken from | the first paid ECHO claim of the month among the family |
| Treatment of months with no ECHO benefit | no cost share |
| When a sponsor pay-grade change moves the registration to another tier | the first calendar month after DEERS records the new pay grade |

## Reading the schedule

- The cost share is a family amount, not a per-beneficiary amount: two or more registered children of one sponsor who all receive ECHO benefits in the same calendar month still give rise to 1 monthly cost share for that month.
- A calendar month with no ECHO benefit for anyone in the family carries no cost share in any tier.
- The amount in the table is the full monthly cost share of the tier; it is the same whatever the number or size of the family's ECHO claims in the month.

## Hypothetical illustrations

*Hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*

| Sponsor pay grade on record | Family ECHO benefits in the calendar month | Monthly cost share for that month |
|---|---|---|
| E-4 | one child, one paid claim | 25.00 |
| O-3 | two children, several paid claims | 45.00, once for the family |
| W-5 | none | no cost share |
| O-9 | one child, one paid claim | 150.00 |

*Hypothetical pay-grade change:* DEERS records a sponsor's promotion from E-6 to E-7 during a given month. That month remains in the Sponsor E-6 tier at 30.00; the tier of the new grade, Sponsor E-7 and O-1 at 35.00, applies from the first calendar month after the month DEERS recorded the new grade.
